title: Range Operator
instructions: What operator creates an inclusive range in Kotlin?
prompt: To create a range from 1 to 10 (inclusive) in Kotlin, you write 1___10
explanation: The `..` operator creates an inclusive range. `1..10` means every number from 1 to 10, including both 1 and 10. If you want to exclude the end, use `until` instead (e.g. `1 until 10` goes from 1 to 9).
